directory.name: South Town Pie
directory.note: New York-style pizza bar in South Park from chef Sam Crannell (formerly of LloydMartin), with a full bar, outdoor seating and pinball machines.

directory.name: Pizzeria 22
directory.note: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizzeria in West Seattle's Admiral district serving Margherita D.O.C. and a weekend wood-fired brunch.

directory.name: Johnny Mo's Pizzeria
directory.note: Chicago-style deep-dish pizzeria that started in a small nook in Eastlake and also serves a Chicago-style slice.
directory.address: 3272 Fuhrman Ave E, Suite 100, Seattle, WA 98102

directory.name: Pazzo's on Eastlake
directory.note: Neighborhood pizza-and-bar spot on Eastlake Ave E with a dining room, lounge and seasonal patio.

directory.name: Soprano's Antico
directory.note: Family-run pizza and pasta restaurant in the Admiral Junction making house-made dough and pasta daily.

directory.name: Pizza Ritual
directory.note: Takeout-only pop-up-turned-permanent pizzeria running out of the KBM Kitchen walk-up window, serving naturally leavened Neapolitan-style pizza Friday and Saturday evenings.

directory.name: Pizzeria Pulcinella
directory.note: Long-running wood-fired Neapolitan pizzeria on Rainier Ave S, marked by a red glowing 'Wood Fire Pizza' sign, serving margherita pies and pasta.

directory.name: Romano Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Long-running Delridge pizza-and-pasta shop (formerly Olympia Pizza & Pasta) also serving calzones and Greek specialties.
